subject.title: fix: deleting a session leaves its trajectory artifacts orphaned on disk

question: Should this PR become the canonical owner of reset-time trajectory preservation, superseding or absorbing the overlapping implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94593?
rationale: Both branches establish persistence and retention policy for sensitive trajectory records through different lifecycle owners; mechanical code repair cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Use this lifecycle design
options.body: Repair both P1 defects here, then rebase and close or narrow the overlapping reset PR after confirming equivalent coverage.

options.title: Keep delete repair narrow
options.body: Retain only the delete-orphan fix here and let the overlapping PR own reset-time preservation and override-directory retention.

recommendation.title: Use this lifecycle design
recommendation.body: Repair both P1 defects here, then rebase and close or narrow the overlapping reset PR after confirming equivalent coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and current GitHub decision owner for this overlapping lifecycle change.
